title: P2 secret.revoke: request
description: Revocation on compromise (farmctl secret revoke --compromised, SEC-6). With secret: a credential that the core issued (a worker token, a program key, a handle) stops working from the next call without an overlap window, and in the same operation the core sets a hold without expiry with reason compromised on every scope where the deployment description uses the secret (channel, plugin, worker, sink, tenant); only the operator releases it (HLD-2). With connections: every active or pending connection of the provider (SEC-7), in the named tenant or in all tenants, is revoked in one transaction with reason compromised, and the consent adapter is asked to delete the tokens and revoke them at the provider. Exactly one of secret and connections.

secret.description: Name of the deployment secret or of a credential that the core issued.

compromised.description: Only the compromise path; a planned rotation uses the overlap window.

connections.description: Bulk revocation of people's connections to one provider (SEC-6, SEC-7).

tenant.description: Only this tenant; all tenants when absent.
